guide_solution: The passage is about the life and activities of Dr. Muhammad Shahidullah. He was a prominent Bengali linguist, and educationist known for his significant contributions to the study of languages. Born on July 10, 1885, in Dhaka, he began his career as a professor of Dhaka University. He played a key role in the development of linguistic research in South Asia. His dedication to education and linguistic scholarship is visible in his book Bangla Sahityer Kotha published in 1928. This great scholar remained busy with his scholarly work until he died in 1969.
